concern: Breathless and tired for two days, no chest pain at all
what_keeps_it_open: Diabetic for thirty years. No pain anywhere. Breathless climbing stairs, which is new for her. Looks grey. Long-standing neuropathy means she may not feel cardiac pain the way another patient would.
medication_effect: Metformin and bisoprolol; the beta-blocker will blunt any compensatory tachycardia.

lookups.question: Does a patient with cardiac risk factors and no chest pain still meet a high-risk criterion?
What aggregate score triggers clinical escalation and an emergency response?
